tasks.label: QuadControl: Clean
tasks.command: rm -rf build install log src/quadcontrol_core/build src/quadcontrol_core/install src/quadcontrol_core/log

tasks.label: QuadControl: Test
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && colcon test --event-handlers console_direct+ && colcon test-result --verbose

tasks.label: QuadControl: Coverage
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && colcon --log-base log/coverage build --packages-up-to quadcontrol_core --build-base build/coverage --install-base install/coverage --cmake-args -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DQUADCONTROL_ENABLE_COVERAGE=ON && colcon --log-base log/coverage test --packages-select quadcontrol_core --build-base build/coverage --install-base install/coverage --event-handlers console_direct+ && colcon test-result --test-result-base build/coverage --verbose && gcovr --root . --filter 'src/quadcontrol_core/(src|include)/.*' --txt-summary --xml-pretty --xml build/coverage/coverage.xml && python3 src/quadcontrol_core/test/merge_test_coverage.py --test-results-dir build/coverage/quadcontrol_core/test_results/quadcontrol_core --coverage-xml build/coverage/coverage.xml --output build/coverage/test-and-coverage.xml --html-output build/coverage/test-and-coverage.html
